trailhead.label: The car park in Chiareggio, the board’s start

cautions: Cattle graze the pastures around the huts in summer: keep your distance and your dog close.
Stony mule track with loose stones in places: watch your dog’s paws.
Storms build fast on summer afternoons at this height.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
